_about: Hometowns copy, en-GB (WP8). Every entry has kid and adult text; kidLess/adultLess, where present, are used for a negative amount. Slots: {x} number grouped or string as is; {x:n} whole number; {x:signed} +12/−3; {x:money} £12,345; {x:signedMoney} +£1,200; {x:pct} 0.38 → 38%; {x:bp} 250 → 2.5%; {x:stars} 0–100 → ★0–5 in halves; {x:time} game ticks as weeks/months/years; {x:ms} real milliseconds as about N minutes/hours/days; {x:count:one:many} 1 home / 12 homes; {x:ref:prefix} the entry prefix.<x> at the same level. Kid text never prints a raw string: string slots there are always refs. Renderer: src/lib/games/hometowns/engine/copy.ts.

advisorName.zia.adult: Zia the otter, Fun and Visitors

advisor.penny.reservesLow.kid: Our money box is nearly empty. Let's look at the dials together.
advisor.penny.reservesLow.adult: Reserves cover less than a month of spending. A small tax rise or lower funding would rebuild them.

advisor.penny.deficit.kid: I'd love more coins coming in than going out. Shall we check the dials?
advisor.penny.deficit.adult: Spending is running ahead of income. Taxes and funding are in the budget.

advisor.penny.helper.kid: Kingsport is helping with our money for a while. Let's save up together.
advisor.penny.helper.adult: Helper Mode is on: Kingsport covers the shortfall while the budget recovers.

advisor.penny.debtHeavy.kid: Paying back our loan takes lots of coins. Let's not borrow more yet.
advisor.penny.debtHeavy.adult: Loan and bond payments take over 18% of income. More borrowing would cost us our rating.

advisor.penny.ratingLow.kid: Banks would like to see our savings grow before they lend more.
advisor.penny.ratingLow.adult: The credit rating has slipped. Steady surpluses lift it a notch every three months.

advisor.penny.loanForBuilding.kid: We could borrow coins to build something big, then pay them back.
advisor.penny.loanForBuilding.adult: There is room to borrow. A Town Loan could pay for a big project now.

advisor.penny.surplus.kid: Our money box is full! Let's build something lovely.
advisor.penny.surplus.adult: Reserves cover over six months of spending. That money could be working for the town.

advisor.penny.taxHigh.kid: People would love a lower Town Tax.
advisor.penny.taxHigh.adult: Homes tax is above 12%. Residents feel it in happiness and approval, even when they stay.

advisor.penny.businessTaxHigh.kid: Shops and factories would love a lower business tax.
advisor.penny.businessTaxHigh.adult: Business tax above 7% squeezes margins, so businesses grow more slowly.

advisor.penny.factoriesPay.kid: Factories want to come here. They would bring jobs and coins.
advisor.penny.factoriesPay.adult: Industry demand is strong: new factory tiles would add jobs and business tax.

advisor.mo.jobsWanted.kid: Lots of people would love a job. New shops would help.
advisor.mo.jobsWanted.adult: Unemployment is above 8%. Shops and factories add jobs, entry-level roles first.

advisor.mo.homesWanted.kid: People are waiting to move here. Let's paint more homes!
advisor.mo.homesWanted.adult: The waiting list for homes is long. More Homes zoning near roads would let them in.

advisor.mo.squeezed.kid: Some families' homes cost too much. More homes would help.
advisor.mo.squeezed.adult: Some households are squeezed by rents they can't afford. Extra homes would ease them.

advisor.mo.needs.kid: Families would love a few more things near home.
advisor.mo.needs.adult: Several needs are met for under half of residents. The People sheet shows which.

advisor.mo.schools.kid: Families would love more school places.
advisor.mo.schools.adult: The Schools star is low. A school near Families would lift it and draw more of them.

advisor.mo.primarySeats.kid: Children need more seats at primary school.
advisor.mo.primarySeats.adult: Primary seats cover under 80% of children. A Primary School would close the gap.

advisor.mo.secondarySeats.kid: Older children would love a big school place.
advisor.mo.secondarySeats.adult: Secondary seats cover under 75% of teenagers. A Secondary School would close the gap.

advisor.mo.health.kid: People would love a doctor close by.
advisor.mo.health.adult: Health cover is thin. A Doctor's Surgery or Health Centre would lift the Health star.

advisor.mo.safety.kid: People would feel safer with a constable nearby.
advisor.mo.safety.adult: The Safety star is low. Police cover helps, and so do jobs and things to do.

advisor.mo.homesStar.kid: People would love homes that cost less.
advisor.mo.homesStar.adult: The Homes star is low: rents are high for local incomes. More homes would help.

advisor.mo.jobsStar.kid: People would love jobs closer to home.
advisor.mo.jobsStar.adult: The Jobs star is low: too few jobs within reach. More business zoning or faster roads would help.

advisor.mo.taxStar.kid: People think our taxes are a bit high.
advisor.mo.taxStar.adult: The Tax star is low. Residents compare our rates with the rest of the county.

advisor.mo.unhappy.kid: Some people feel a bit grumpy. Let's see what they wish for.
advisor.mo.unhappy.adult: Mood is below 45. Town Talk shows what residents want most.

advisor.mo.approval.kid: People would love to see their wishes come true.
advisor.mo.approval.adult: Approval is under 50. Ticking off the checklist and Town Talk wishes raises it.

advisor.zia.fun.kid: Children would love a park to play in!
advisor.zia.fun.adult: The Fun star is low. A park or playground near homes would lift it.

advisor.zia.culture.kid: People would love a hall for shows and clubs.
advisor.zia.culture.adult: The Culture star is low. A Community Hall, Library or Museum builds culture over time.

advisor.zia.nature.kid: People would love more trees and green spaces.
advisor.zia.nature.adult: The Nature star is low. Parks and greens near homes help, and they soak up smoke.

advisor.zia.buzz.kid: Let's give people something new to talk about!
advisor.zia.buzz.adult: Buzz is low. A new attraction gets the town talked about.

advisor.zia.hotels.kid: Visitors love it here, but there's nowhere to stay. Hotels?
advisor.zia.hotels.adult: Visitors outnumber beds. Leisure zoning grows hotels and keeps their spending in town.

advisor.zia.crowded.kid: It's busy with visitors! A new place to visit would spread them out.
advisor.zia.crowded.adult: Visitors are crowding the attractions. Another one spreads them out and protects our reputation.

advisor.zia.visitorsUnhappy.kid: Visitors would love more to see and do.
advisor.zia.visitorsUnhappy.adult: Visitor satisfaction is under 50, so reputation will slip. Better attractions would lift it.

advisor.zia.leisure.kid: People would love cafés and fun places. Let's paint some Leisure!
advisor.zia.leisure.adult: Leisure demand is high. Leisure zoning adds cafés, venues and hotel beds.

advisor.bramble.power.kid: Some homes have no power. Let's build a windmill!
advisor.bramble.power.adult: Some tiles have no power. A power source joined to the roads would reach them.

advisor.bramble.water.kid: Some homes need water. A well would help!
advisor.bramble.water.adult: Some tiles are dry. A well or water tower joined to the roads would reach them.

advisor.bramble.brownout.kid: We need a bit more power at busy times.
advisor.bramble.brownout.adult: Demand is outrunning supply, so some areas lose power. Add supply or buy from Kingsport.

advisor.bramble.shops.adult: Shops demand is strong. Shops zoning near homes would meet it.

advisor.bramble.offices.kid: Offices want to open here. Let's paint some!
advisor.bramble.offices.adult: Office demand is strong. Offices start at level 3, so they need good land value.

advisor.bramble.farms.adult: Farm demand is strong. Farms feed the town and sell food to the county.

advisor.bramble.traffic.kid: The roads are getting busy. A bigger road would help.
advisor.bramble.traffic.adult: Roads are congested. An avenue on the busiest route, or a bus line, would ease it.

advisor.bramble.commutes.kid: Trips to work take a long time. Better roads would help.
advisor.bramble.commutes.adult: The Getting around star is low. The Traffic lens shows where trips are slow.

advisor.bramble.pollution.kid: Some places are smoky. Trees and parks would help.
advisor.bramble.pollution.adult: Pollution is high. Parks absorb it; Clean Air Rules and cleaner power cut it.

advisor.bramble.almostThere.kid: We're nearly ready to grow! Just a few things to go.
advisor.bramble.almostThere.adult: The next tier's checklist is more than half done. The Growth sheet shows what's left.

advisor.bramble.checklist.kid: Here's what our town needs to grow next.
advisor.bramble.checklist.adult: Several checklist items remain for the next tier. The Growth sheet lists them.

advisor.bramble.struggling.kid: Let's work out what our town needs, together.
advisor.bramble.struggling.adult: The town is struggling. The recovery sheet suggests steps in order.

tierUp.0.kid: Your hamlet is on the map!

tierUp.1.adult: Promoted to Village: split taxes and standing orders unlock.

inbox.promotion.kid: We're a {tier:ref:tier} now! Pick {parcels:count:new patch:new patches} of land.

building.townHall.kid: Where you work, Mayor! It keeps the town a bit safe too.
building.townHall.adult: Free at founding. Gives some police and fire cover nearby; its staff grow with the town.

building.busDepot.kid: A home for the buses. You need one before bus lines can run.
building.busDepot.adult: Enables bus lines. Upkeep rises with the network.

building.busStop.kid: Buses pick people up here. Fewer cars on the road!
building.busStop.adult: On a road; transit cover in a radius of 4. Up to 35% of trips can switch to the bus.

building.railStation.kid: Trains stop here to take people far and fast.
building.railStation.adult: A rail node with wide transit cover. Needs track to another station or a link.

building.freightYard.kid: Trains carry goods to other towns from here.
building.freightYard.adult: FreightScore +0.25 with a rail link, so industry exports more cheaply.

building.harbour.kid: Boats carry goods from here. Visitors like to watch them.
building.harbour.adult: Coast only. FreightScore +0.35 and a little visitor appeal.

building.airfield.kid: Little planes bring visitors and business. It is very noisy.
building.airfield.adult: Outside World gate +0.2 and more office demand, at a cost in noise and pollution.

building.well.kid: Fresh water for a few homes. Cheap to build.
building.well.adult: Small water supply. Cheap to build, dear to run per unit at scale.

building.windmill.kid: The wind turns the sails and makes power. Clean and quiet.
building.windmill.adult: Small clean power supply with a little noise.

building.generator.kid: Makes more power, but puffs out a bit of smoke.
building.generator.adult: Twice a windmill's power, with some pollution.

building.waterTower.kid: Holds lots of water for a growing village.
building.waterTower.adult: Ten times a well's water at a lower cost per unit.

building.windTurbine.kid: A tall, clean windmill. Extra good on hills and by the sea.
building.windTurbine.adult: Clean power; ×1.3 on Hills and Coast sites.

building.coalPlant.kid: Makes lots of power, but it is very smoky.
building.coalPlant.adult: Cheap, plentiful and dirty: heavy pollution drives Families and visitors away.

building.gasPlant.kid: Makes lots of power with less smoke than coal.
building.gasPlant.adult: Coal's output with under half its pollution, at a higher running cost.

building.pumpingStation.kid: Pumps water to a whole town.

building.solarFarm.adult: Clean power with very low upkeep; takes space.

building.waterWorks.kid: Cleans river or sea water for a big city.

building.constablePost.kid: A friendly constable helps people feel safe.
building.constablePost.adult: Police cover in a radius of 10, for up to 3,000 people.

building.policeStation.kid: Lots of constables help a big town feel safe.
building.policeStation.adult: Police cover in a radius of 18, for up to 25,000 people.

building.fireVolunteers.kid: Brave helpers who put out fires.
building.fireVolunteers.adult: Fire cover in a radius of 10, for up to 1,500 people.

building.fireStation.kid: Fire engines ready to help, day and night.
building.fireStation.adult: Fire cover in a radius of 18, for up to 25,000 people.

building.surgery.kid: A doctor who helps people get better.
building.surgery.adult: Health cover in a radius of 10, for up to 2,500 people.

building.healthCentre.kid: Doctors and nurses for a whole town.
building.healthCentre.adult: Health cover in a radius of 18, for up to 12,000 people.

building.hospital.kid: A big hospital that helps everyone in town.
building.hospital.adult: Town-wide health cover. Can share places with linked towns within 40 minutes.

building.schoolHouse.kid: A little school for the first children.

building.villageSchool.kid: A school with room for a whole village.

building.primarySchool.kid: A big school for younger children.

building.secondarySchool.kid: A big school for older children.
building.secondarySchool.adult: 1,200 secondary seats. Needed for Town and up.

building.library.kid: Books for everyone! People learn more here.
building.library.adult: Culture over time and Edu +15 within its radius.

building.university.kid: Students come from far away to learn here.
building.university.adult: 6,000 places; unlocks Students, who pay fees. Large culture boost.

building.villageGreen.kid: Grass to play on and a nice place to sit.
building.villageGreen.adult: Cheap Fun and Nature cover; a small visitor draw.

building.pocketPark.kid: A tiny park between the houses.
building.pocketPark.adult: Cheap, small Fun and Nature cover.

building.park.kid: Trees, paths and grass. It cleans the air too.
building.park.adult: Fun and Nature cover in a radius of 8; absorbs pollution.

building.playground.kid: Swings and slides! Families love it.

building.communityHall.kid: A place for clubs, shows and parties.
building.communityHall.adult: Wide light Fun cover and a little culture.

building.viewpoint.kid: A great spot to look at the view.
building.viewpoint.adult: Needs a scenic spot. A cheap visitor attraction.

building.sportsPitches.kid: Football, cricket and running for everyone.
building.sportsPitches.adult: Strong Fun cover and a small visitor draw.

building.swimmingPool.adult: Strong Fun cover and a little health.

building.cinema.adult: Fun cover, +10 Fun town-wide; tickets offset upkeep. A little noise.

building.youthClub.kid: A fun place for teenagers to hang out.
building.youthClub.adult: Lowers safety pressure by 20% in its radius.

building.botanicGarden.kid: Amazing plants from all over the world.
building.botanicGarden.adult: Wide Nature cover and a strong visitor draw.

building.museum.kid: Old and amazing things to see.

building.theatre.kid: Plays and shows on a real stage.
building.theatre.adult: A big culture and visitor draw, with a little noise.

building.stadium.kid: Huge matches and festivals happen here!
building.stadium.adult: Town-wide Fun, hosts festivals, a big visitor draw; noisy. Tickets offset upkeep.

building.clockTower.kid: A tall clock everyone can see. It makes the streets around it smarter.
building.clockTower.adult: A landmark: culture, appeal and +30 land value nearby.

building.grandPier.kid: A long pier with fun at the end.
building.grandPier.adult: Coast only. A landmark with strong appeal and +20 land value nearby.

building.townLandmark.kid: Your town's very own special building. Pick your favourite design!
building.townLandmark.adult: One per town; six designs. The biggest culture, appeal and land value boost.

zone.homes.kid: Paint land for homes. Builders come when people want to move in.
zone.homes.adult: Grows homes when the Homes meter is up. Land value decides the tier: £, ££ or £££.

zone.shops.kid: Paint land for shops. People shop near home.
zone.shops.adult: Grows shops from local and visiting spending. L1 hires £ workers only.

zone.leisure.kid: Cafés, venues and hotels for visitors and locals.
zone.leisure.adult: Leisure jobs and hotel beds. Unlocks at Town.

zone.industry.kid: Factories make things and give lots of jobs. They can be smoky.
zone.industry.adult: Goods and jobs; pollution until L5's clean makers' sheds.

zone.offices.kid: Offices bring top jobs. They need nice land.
zone.offices.adult: Start at L3, so they need good land value. Mostly ££ and £££ jobs.

zone.farms.kid: Fields grow food for the town.
zone.farms.adult: Food for local use and sale. Can only be newly zoned up to Town.

road.lane.kid: A little road. Homes and shops grow next to roads.
road.lane.adult: Cheap, slow, low capacity. Zoned tiles need a road within 2.

road.street.kid: A wider road for more cars.
road.street.adult: Three times a lane's capacity, a little faster.

road.avenue.kid: A big road for busy towns.
road.avenue.adult: High capacity and fast. Unlocks at Town.

road.county.kid: The road to Kingsport. It was here first!
road.county.adult: Built in at founding. Free and permanent.

road.rail.kid: Trains are quick and carry lots of people.
road.rail.adult: Fastest travel; riders board at stations. Unlocks at City.

policy.litterPickers.kid: Helpers keep the town tidy. Nature and visitors like it.
policy.litterPickers.adult: Nature +5 and tourism quality +3%, for a small cost per resident.

policy.neighbourhoodWatch.kid: Neighbours look out for each other, so streets feel safer.

policy.farmersMarket.kid: A market for local food. Shops do better, but fewer farm jobs.
policy.farmersMarket.adult: Shops meter +10 and Fun +5; farm jobs −10%.

policy.smokeAlarms.kid: Alarms in every home help stop fires early.

policy.cleanAirRules.kid: Factories must puff out less smoke. It costs them a bit more.

policy.nightMarket.kid: Stalls and lights at night! Fun, but a bit noisy.
policy.nightMarket.adult: Fun +8 and leisure spending +8%; noise in shop cells and a little safety pressure.

policy.freeBusFridays.kid: Buses are free on Fridays, so more people ride.
policy.freeBusFridays.adult: Bus share +25%, paid for in lost fares.

policy.readingChallenge.kid: Everyone reads more books. People learn more.

policy.treePlanting.kid: Plant lots of trees. Cleaner air and prettier views.

policy.startupHoliday.kid: New businesses pay no business tax for a while.
policy.startupHoliday.adult: New business tiles pay no business tax for 12 months; less revenue now.

policy.shortLetLimits.kid: Homes stay homes and don't turn into holiday flats.

policy.tourismPromotion.kid: Posters tell everyone about our town.
policy.tourismPromotion.adult: Awareness grows three times faster and Buzz +5; residents tire of crowds sooner.

policy.keepHomesAffordable.kid: Homes in this area stay cheaper for the people who live there.
policy.keepHomesAffordable.adult: Painted area: no re-tiering, rent ×0.8; homes tax yield there −20%.

policy.heritageProtection.kid: Old buildings in this area are kept just as they are.
policy.heritageProtection.adult: Painted area: heritage culture ×1.5 and more appeal; protected tiles cannot level up.

policy.carFreeCentre.kid: No cars in the middle of town. Quieter and nicer!
policy.carFreeCentre.adult: Painted area: noise −40% and more Leisure; car times ×1.3 inside it.

policy.greenEnergyPledge.kid: We promise to use clean power only.
policy.greenEnergyPledge.adult: Blocks coal; Nature +5 and culture +1 a month.

event.factoryBoom.kid: Everyone wants goods! Factories sell more.

event.techFair.kid: Offices are busy with new ideas.

event.rainySpell.kid: Lots of rain, so fewer visitors.

event.buildersShortage.kid: Builders are on holiday, so building takes longer.

event.bumperHarvest.kid: Farms grew loads of food. Food is cheaper.

event.cosyWinter.kid: Chilly days, so homes use more power.

event.bigConcert.kid: A big concert in the county! More day trips.

event.sunnyWeekend.kid: Sunshine! People go out for day trips.

event.ferryFun.kid: Ferries bring visitors to seaside towns.

order.budgetHealthy.kid: If money runs low, I'll turn down fun spending, then nudge Town Tax up a little. I never borrow.
order.budgetHealthy.adult: If reserves are under {a0} months of spending and falling: set Fun and Culture to Low, then raise homes tax by up to {a1:bp} in total. Never borrows.

order.buyUtilities.kid: If we run short of power or water, I'll buy some from Kingsport.
order.buyUtilities.adult: Buy missing power and water from Kingsport.

order.fixDamaged.kid: If something gets broken, I'll pay for repairs.

order.renewContracts.kid: If a deal you made ends, I'll make it again. But only if it was good for us.
order.renewContracts.adult: Renew contracts I made, unless they lost money.

order.awayZoning.kid: While you're away, I'll paint a few homes or shops by the roads. Only if people want them!
order.awayZoning.adult: While away: zone up to {a0} Homes or Shops tiles a day next to roads when that meter is above {a1} and reserves exceed {a2} months of spending.

order.repayLoan.kid: If we have lots of savings, I'll pay the loan back early.
order.repayLoan.adult: Repay the Town Loan early when reserves exceed {a0} months of spending.

order.hold.kid: Don't change anything. I'll just watch.

bramble.ordersIntro.kid: I look after the town when you're busy. Here's what I'll do.
bramble.ordersIntro.adult: Standing orders run every pay day. Everything the Deputy does appears in your welcome back.

deputy.budgetHealthy.funding.kid: Money was low, so I turned down fun spending for now.
deputy.budgetHealthy.funding.adult: Reserves were down to {months} months of spending: Fun and Culture funding set to Low.

deputy.budgetHealthy.tax.kid: Money was still low, so I nudged Town Tax up a little.
deputy.budgetHealthy.tax.adult: Reserves still falling: homes tax raised by {bp:bp}.

deputy.awayZoning.kid: People wanted homes and shops, so I painted some for you.
deputy.awayZoning.adult: Zoned {homes:count:Homes tile:Homes tiles} and {shops:count:Shops tile:Shops tiles} while you were away.

deputy.repayLoan.kid: We had lots of savings, so I paid some of the loan back.
deputy.repayLoan.adult: Repaid {paid:money} of the Town Loan early.

deputy.buyUtilities.kid: We ran short of power or water, so I bought some from Kingsport.
deputy.buyUtilities.adult: Bought {power:n} power and {water:n} water from Kingsport for {cost:money}.

welcomeBack.away.kid: Welcome back! While you were away, {ticks:time} went by in your town.
welcomeBack.away.adult: Welcome back. Time in town since your last visit: {ticks:time}.

welcomeBack.people.kid: {pop:count:person lives:people live} in your town now.

welcomeBack.inbox.kid: You have {n:count:new letter:new letters} in your mail.

welcomeBack.deputy.kid: Bramble did {n:count:job:jobs} for you while you were away.
welcomeBack.deputy.adult: The Deputy acted {n:count:time:times} while you were away.

bulletin.grew.kid: {n:count:new person:new people} moved in! Now {pop:n} live here.

bulletin.shrank.kid: {n:count:person:people} moved away. Let's see what people want.
bulletin.shrank.adult: Population down {n:n} to {pop:n}. Town Talk shows why.

bulletin.steady.kid: Everyone stayed put. {pop:n} people live here.

bulletin.movedIn.kid: {n:count:new face:new faces} moved in. Most were {cohort:ref:cohort}.

bulletin.homesComing.kid: {n:count:home is:homes are} being built right now.

bulletin.moneyDown.kid: We spent {amount:money} more than came in. Penny has ideas.

bulletin.quiet.kid: A calm, happy day in town.

bulletin.founded.kid: Special edition: a new town is on the map!
bulletin.founded.adult: Special edition: a new town is founded.

founding.pickSite.kid: Pick a place for your town.

founding.nameTyped.kid: Ask a grown-up to type a name

founding.nameWaiting.kid: A grown-up will check your name soon.
founding.nameWaiting.adult: This name is waiting for a parent's approval.

founding.done.kid: Your town is on the map! Let's build.
founding.done.adult: Founded. Bramble will walk you through the first steps.

site.river.adult: River: fertile land and water nearby

site.coast.adult: Coast: beaches, a harbour and visitors

site.hills.adult: Hills: great views and strong wind

site.forest.adult: Forest: nature all round; clearing costs

site.flatland.adult: Flatland: easy to build on everywhere

tutorial.hello.kid: Hello, Mayor, I'm Bramble, your helper! Let's join the County Road!
tutorial.hello.adult: Hello, Mayor. I'm Bramble, your Deputy. First, let's join the County Road.

tutorial.road.kid: Drag a lane from the signpost. Follow the glowing arrow!
tutorial.road.adult: Drag a lane from the County Road signpost.

tutorial.roadDone.kid: Lovely road! Now people can get here.
tutorial.roadDone.adult: Connected. Homes and shops grow within 2 tiles of a road.

tutorial.homes.kid: Now paint 12 Homes next to your lane.
tutorial.homes.adult: Paint 12 or more Homes tiles beside the lane.

tutorial.homesMore.adult: {n:count:more Homes tile:more Homes tiles} to reach 12.

tutorial.homesDone.kid: Brilliant! Lots of room for new families.
tutorial.homesDone.adult: Enough homes for the founders' carts.

tutorial.farms.kid: Paint 2 Farms so everyone has food.
tutorial.farms.adult: Paint 2 Farms tiles for local food.

tutorial.well.kid: Now put a Well near the homes for water.
tutorial.well.adult: Place a Well on the road network for water.

tutorial.farmsDone.kid: Food and water. Our hamlet is ready!

tutorial.buildIt.kid: Happy with your plan? Tap Build it!
tutorial.buildIt.adult: Review the forecast, then tap Build it!

tutorial.ghosts.kid: See-through things are just a plan. Nothing is built until you say so.
tutorial.ghosts.adult: Ghosts are free and undoable until you commit.

sprint.payDay.adult: Pay day: the month's books are in.

sprint.special.kid: Special edition: your town is in the paper!
sprint.special.adult: A Gazette special edition marks your founding.

sprint.done.kid: Your hamlet keeps growing while you're away. Come back after tea to see it!
sprint.done.adult: The Founding Fortnight is over. The county clock takes it from here.

sprint.auto.kid: Bramble played the last weeks for you.
sprint.auto.adult: Untapped founding weeks ran at the Regional Day.

undo.blocked.kid: Something else needs this now, so it can't be undone.
undo.blocked.adult: Can't undo: something now depends on this plan.

undo.tooLate.kid: This was built before today, so it stays.
undo.tooLate.adult: Undo is only possible before the next Regional Day.

plan.noRoad.kid: Red tiles are too far from a road.
plan.noRoad.adult: Red tiles have no road within 2.

plan.bulldozePrivate.kid: The land stays painted, but the building goes.
plan.bulldozePrivate.adult: Private buildings become empty zoned land, with no refund.

plan.bulldozeRefund.kid: Built today, so you get half the coins back.

bramble.break.kid: You've been busy, Mayor! Time for a stretch and a drink?
bramble.break.adult: You've been playing for a while. A short break?

bramble.sessionEnd.kid: Lovely work. I'll keep an eye on things.
bramble.sessionEnd.adult: Lovely work. I'll keep an eye on things.

helper.on.kid: Kingsport is helping with our money while we save up. Nothing gets knocked down.
helper.on.adult: Kingsport is covering the shortfall. Nothing is demolished; the advance is written off after 10 days if needed.

helper.steps.kid: Penny will try small changes to get us back on track.
helper.steps.adult: Each step trims spending or raises a tax a little, in order, until the budget balances.

helper.off.kid: We're back on our own feet. Well done!

lens.happy.kid: Where people are happy, and where they are grumpy.

lens.landValue.kid: Where land is cheap, and where it is pricey.
lens.landValue.adult: Land value (1–250). Tap a cell for its top terms.

lens.pollution.adult: Pollution, spread by wind and soaked up by parks.

lens.noise.adult: Noise from roads, venues and industry.

lens.schools.kid: Where children can get a school place.
lens.schools.adult: School cover; seats used against capacity.

lens.fun.kid: Where there's fun to be had.

lens.culture.kid: Where the shows and clubs are.

lens.utilities.adult: Power and water supply, with outages.

lens.jobs.kid: Where jobs are easy to get to.

lens.desirability.kid: Where would people like to live?
lens.desirability.adult: Desirability for a chosen face and tier.
